The Jade Rabbit Who Fell into the Dragon Palace

description:
"Eat me." 

So-ok, a moon rabbit from the Palace of the Moon, is captured and brought to the Dragon Palace for the crime of stealing and eating the Wolryeongcho herb. The herb was supposed to be sent to the Dragon Palace for the Dragon King's successor. To avoid ending up in a rabbit stew, So-ok improvises a lie. So-ok lowered her voice to a whisper. A small, red rabbit tongue licked the corner of her mouth. 

"Eat me raw. By biting, licking, and sucking." Thus, So-ok begins to spend days of ecstasy with Gwang, the successor to the Dragon King...
